usage.finalMessage:
I added `run-interest`, which charges DEC-B14 collection interest once per invoice: 1% of the invoice amount, starting more than 60 days after the due date. The interest counts toward the invoice's outstanding amount and the customer's balance. `help` lists the command right after `run-late-fees`, and `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 11 of 11, including five extra tests I added. The work and `.work/report.json` are committed.
One open question for Credit Control: I assumed nonprofits pay no interest, the same way they pay no late fees. DEC-B14 doesn't say. `show` keeps its old format, so it has no separate interest field, but its outstanding figure includes the interest.

OUTCOME: completed
